improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try three free searches, then unlock unlimited access from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">

<meta property="og:type" content="website">

<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">

improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating the product value and free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, and Twitter—critical for B2B audiences. Including the price anchor and free searches creates urgency without overpromising. All claims are verified from site context.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Partner"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — the intelligent assistant built for business owners, traders, and professionals. Get instant answers, voice chat, and expert support. Try three free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This headline clearly positions Gideon as a partnership rather than just a tool, building trust. The subheading efficiently communicates the target audience, key features (instant answers, voice chat, support), and the low-friction entry point (three free searches) without making unverified claims. The word 'today' creates subtle urgency while remaining professional.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to choose a membership plan to continue. Plans start from just US$2 per day, billed monthly or annually—with annual billing saving you 30 percent. As a member, you'll unlock unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered workspace, voice chat, and professional trade and business support.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model—what happens at the paywall. By clearly explaining the transition from free to paid, stating exact pricing, and reinforcing the value unlocked, it reduces uncertainty and builds trust, helping convert trial users into paying members.
